title: Kuaishou raises $2.8 billion for Kling AI subsidiary with Tencent backing
description: Kuaishou Technology raised 19 billion yuan ($2.79 billion) for its Kling AI subsidiary. The deal values the AI-driven creator platform at roughly $15 billion and reduces Kuaishou's stake to 68%.
